Chapter 783: Chapter 8 Information From Other Dimensions (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 783: Chapter 8 Information from Other Dimensions (Please Subscribe)

What Lin Yuan saw in the sixth-level reward list actually belonged to the treasures and rare items from the seventh level and even some from the eighth-level reward vault.

After all, the rewards ultimately obtained for passing each level of the Black Tower were contingent on one’s performance during the challenge.

As a Tenth-Rank lifeform, Lin Yuan’s performance in passing the sixth level was undoubtedly top-tier, even vastly surpassing the highest standard of performance.

Therefore, reflected on the reward list, the level of reward he could choose from was raised by several tiers.

The various rewards Lin Yuan had chosen earlier were also of this nature, which is why items like the World Tree and the Source of Metal Essence, both Eleven-Star rarities, appeared on the second-level reward list.

“Three rewards?”

...

There were only three items on the reward list in front of Lin Yuan.

They were—

Infinity World.

Cosmic Demise.

Heart of Space-Time.

Lin Yuan hadn’t heard of these three rewards, but he had a vague sense that they were incomparably precious, with few equivalents even in the Human Civilization Treasury.

“Senior Shen Ji, what are these three treasures?” Lin Yuan quietly inquired.

“The Infinite World originated from the time when the tower master was pursuing the traces of the Perfect Time Being. He discovered a broken world that is suspected to have once been visited by the Perfect Time Being…”

Stone Statue Shen Ji smiled at Lin Yuan and said, “However, this is just the tower master’s speculation. Even if it wasn’t visited by a Perfect Time Being, it was left by a powerhouse very close to the Perfect Temporal Life.”

“The tower master has studied this Infinite World for a long time with little gain.”

“Perfect Time Being?” Lin Yuan’s expression became slightly solemn. According to Shen Ji, the Infinite World was at least related to a powerhouse nearly equivalent to the Perfect Time Being.

So far, Lin Yuan had only come into contact with one such entity.

That was the creator of the two-dimensional world.

“What about Cosmic Demise?” Lin Yuan asked again.

“Ah, Cosmic Demise…” Stone Statue Shen Ji pondered for a while, then continued, “You should know that the cosmos will come to ruin.”

“Yes.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

The cosmos goes from birth to destruction through an unimaginable expanse of long years, a cycle known as a Cosmic Era.

“The destruction of the cosmos, the collapse of rules and the Great Dao, it is a disaster for every Twelfth-Rank life in the cosmos, with half or even most of them dying.”

“Cosmic Demise is actually a set of replicated imprints that record the whole process of a cosmos’s beginning of destruction to complete annihilation.”

Stone Statue Shen Ji paused for a moment before continuing, “The ruin of the cosmos is a disaster, but also an opportunity. If one can carefully experience the process of the collapse of myriad rules and Great Daos, it can greatly enhance one’s understanding of rules.”

“I see.” Lin Yuan nodded, immediately realizing the value of this record of Cosmic Demise.

To replicate the complete event of Cosmic Demise, one must be a Twelfth-Rank life in the cosmos.

Yet facing the grand destruction of the cosmos, all Twelfth-Rank lives that have not survived a Cosmic Era are extremely cautious and careful; how could they spare the effort to replicate this scene?

And to replicate, one must survive the entire round of cosmic destruction, which is essentially a death wish.

“Lastly, the Heart of Space-Time…” Stone Statue Shen Ji looked at Lin Yuan, “Once fused with the Heart of Space-Time, any being below the Twelfth Rank can extend their time of liberation from the River of Time.”

“Extending the time of liberation from the River of Time?” Lin Yuan took a deep breath.

He immediately realized the greatest use of the Heart of Space-Time.

It was to attempt the Ultimate.

For an Eleventh-Rank life to attempt the Ultimate, they need to take the Ultimate Leap, to propel all of themselves out of the River of Time and make a major transcendence of their life essence above the River of Time.

During this period, the time an Eleventh-Rank life remains above the River of Time is very limited. If they could extend this duration, it would definitely enhance the probability of achieving the Ultimate.

An Eleventh Rank powerhouse attempting the Ultimate leaps out of the River of Time, which is a completely different concept from Lin Yuan being taken out of the River of Time by the Xia Qin Supreme Being.

When an Eleventh-Rank life attempts the Ultimate, leaping out of the River of Time will be resisted and suppressed by the entire River of Time.

For the River of Time itself, an Eleventh-Rank life attempting the Ultimate is akin to a ‘fish’ in its own river striving to break free forever; naturally, it will do everything to prevent it.

Whereas Xia Qin Supreme Being taking Lin Yuan out of the River of Time was only temporary, so even if it causes backlash from the River of Time, it won’t be too severe.

“Three treasures, which do you choose?”

Stone Statue Shen Ji looked at Lin Yuan and spoke.

“Heart of Space-Time,” Lin Yuan said without hesitation.

The origins of Infinity World are immeasurable, at least connected to a great entity close to the Perfect Temporal Life…

But if Lin Yuan does not achieve the Ultimate, the Infinity World, no matter how mystical, would be meaningless.

As for Cosmic Demise? It might be significant and effective for a Supreme Being, but for Lin Yuan, it was slightly beyond what he needed.

In simple terms, both Infinity World and Cosmic Demise were indeed precious, but the most immediate challenge Lin Yuan needed to overcome was attempting the Ultimate.

Without achieving the Ultimate, both would be like flowers in a mirror or the moon reflected on the water.

Therefore.

Choosing the Heart of Space-Time, Lin Yuan had no hesitation.

Extending the time spent above the River of Space-Time… Lin Yuan had never even heard of such a method before.

The treasures and rare items currently possessed by Human Civilization to increase the probability of achieving the Ultimate, such as the Source of the Universe, mainly worked on enhancing the foundation of the one attempting the Ultimate.

Which is entirely a different type from the effects of the Heart of Space-Time.

For example, if attaining the Ultimate is likened to an examination,

then the Source of the Universe’s effect would be akin to the examinee furiously studying before the exam to increase the chances of scoring high.

Whereas the Heart of Space-Time would be akin to directly lowering the difficulty of the paper, achieving the effect of a high score.

While the goal is the same, the principles are utterly different.

“Okay.”

Stone Statue Shen Ji nodded.

At the same time, a crystal that looked like a heart appeared before Lin Yuan.

The crystal was colorless and transparent, and Lin Yuan could vaguely sense that it was slowly beating.

“I should head back now,” said Lin Yuan as he put away the Heart of Space-Time and promptly took his leave.

“Hmm.”

Stone Statue Shen Ji nodded, watching Lin Yuan disappear on the spot.

“The Heart of Space-Time…” Stone Statue Shen Ji fell silent.

In truth, such a rare treasure as the Heart of Space-Time was not a possession from the reward treasuries of the Sixth, Seventh, or even Eighth Layer.

It originated from the core heritage treasury of Moyu Tower, a treasure that only the direct disciples of Moyu Tower, those on the verge of making the ultimate breakthrough, were qualified to enjoy.

By all accounts, Lin Yuan was only a core member of Moyu Tower; he shouldn’t even be eligible to know about such rare treasures, let alone acquire the Heart of Space-Time.

But Moyu Tower today was no longer the Moyu Tower of the past.

Stone Statue Shen Ji was well aware that if they still adhered to the strict requirements for such rare treasures as the Heart of Space-Time, they’d probably decay without ever being used.

Direct disciples of Moyu Tower? One needed to be personally scrutinized by the Moyu Tower Master to have a chance to become one.

But now, the Moyu Tower Master had been missing for countless years, effectively eliminating the possibility of producing a direct disciple.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan’s spirit will returned, bringing back three treasures and rare gems.

“I’ve really struck it rich this time.”

Lin Yuan felt exhilarated; he had anticipated the Origin Source of Metal and the Secret Skill “Milky Way” previously.

But the Heart of Space-Time? Lin Yuan had never imagined he could obtain such a rare treasure.

“The Heart of Space-Time.”

With a thought from Lin Yuan, the heart-shaped crystal appeared before him, beating slowly, emitting an indescribable aura.

“Place it in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.”

With a thought, Lin Yuan’s true body entered the deepest part of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm and solemnly placed the Heart of Space-Time within it.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm was, to Lin Yuan’s knowledge, the safest place, where even Supreme Beings could not enter.

It was not an exaggeration to call it absolutely secure.

A moment later.

Lin Yuan’s mind gradually calmed down.

Although the effects of the Heart of Space-Time were heaven-defying, capable of directly reducing the difficulty of making the ultimate breakthrough, if his own foundation was insufficient, he would still fail to break through to the ultimate.

At least, Stone Statue Shen Ji never said that integrating the Heart of Space-Time would lead to a one hundred percent success rate in becoming the ultimate.

There was no such method in the entire Chaos Void.

“I still need to deepen my own foundation.”

Lin Yuan collected his thoughts and took out the ball of golden light.

That was the Origin Source of Metal.

Sigh.

Following that, a bell-shaped weapon appeared, emanating wisps of suppressive force.

It was Lin Yuan’s Origin Clock that he had been nurturing up to now.

“Merge.”

Lin Yuan infused the Origin Source of Metal into the Origin Clock.

Rumble rumble.

Having devoured the Origin Source of Metal, the Origin Clock immediately began to transform, its aura retracting, rapidly reaching the Tenth Rank Summit, and in the blink of an eye, it pushed into Tier 11, still swiftly climbing.

“I estimate that after completely absorbing the Origin Source of Metal, it will become an Eleventh Rank Peak weapon.”

“By then, once I step into Tier 11, with the compatibility of the Origin Clock and myself, it will be no worse than any ordinary Supreme Weapon.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Even if the Origin Clock reached the Eleventh Rank Peak, it would still be far inferior to a Supreme Weapon.

But other Eleventh Rank Evolvers also couldn’t bring out the full prowess of Supreme Weapons.

Unless the Supreme Weapon contained a contingency from a Supreme Being, the potency of the Origin Clock would not be inferior to that of other Eleventh Rank Powerhouses wielding Supreme Weapons.

Lin Yuan also placed the Origin Clock in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, allowing it to transform slowly.

Lin Yuan then returned to the Milky Way Main Star.

“The Secret Skill ‘Milky Way’.” Lin Yuan immediately took out the crystal stone, which held the Secret Skill “Milky Way.”

After a pause, Lin Yuan immediately sent a sliver of his spirit will into the crystal, beginning to receive the vast messages of the Secret Skill “Milky Way.”

“Wonderful!”

Upon comprehension, Lin Yuan was overjoyed.

Compared to the three Dao-Protecting Secret Skills of the Profound Yellow Lineage, “Milky Way” was more comprehensive, containing the mysteries of space-time, mainly covering the essence of Space-Time Fusion Rules from the Sixfold Realm to the Ninth Realm.

Lin Yuan chose this secret skill, also to prepare for when his own Space-Time Fusion Rules reached the Sixfold Realm.

As Lin Yuan immersed himself in comprehending the Secret Skill “Milky Way,”

a surge from the depths of his mind woke him.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan’s consciousness quickly sank into the depths of his mind, looking towards the majestic and grand Door to the Myriad Realms.
